xmldoc.short_description: Create a timer object that runs commands after a delay or at repeated intervals.

param_input_item.param_description: Value assigned to the timer property.

description.p: timer creates a timer object. A timer object can execute a callback once, after a delay, at a future date, or repeatedly until it completes the requested number of tasks or is stopped.

The callback to execute is stored in the TimerFcn property. The callback can be a function handle, a cell array whose first element is a function handle, a character vector, or a string scalar. Function handle callbacks receive the timer object and an event structure.
Timer objects remain registered after the variable that held them goes out of scope. Use delete when a timer is no longer needed.
Important timer properties are listed below.

tr.td: Action used when fixed-rate timer callbacks cannot run immediately: drop, queue, or error.
Scheduling mode: singleShot, fixedRate, fixedDelay, or fixedSpacing.
Time in seconds between repeated timer executions.
Delay in seconds before the first timer execution.
Number of times to execute TimerFcn. The default value is Inf.
Read-only count of completed timer callback executions.
Read-only value, on while the timer is active and off otherwise.
Visibility used by timerfind. Hidden timers are still returned by timerfindall.

description.p: Use start to start a timer immediately, startat to start it at a specific date and time, stop to stop it, wait to block until it stops, and delete to remove it when it is no longer needed.
